What We Do

Supporting people with intellectual and developmental disabilities in the greater Louisville area.

Residential Options

We have several types of residential options for your loved one, from 24-hour care to semi-independent living options.

Job Services

We can help your loved one find and maintain a meaningful job while building natural relationships in the workplace.

Community Involvement

Let Cedar Lake help your loved one feel more connected to their community. We offer many adult day services that will do just that.

Enrichment Services

We can help connect your loved one to a variety of activities that assist with socialization to build and maintain connections and friendships.

HOW TO HELP

GIVE

With your help, we can ensure the people we support have access to enhanced programs and life-enriching activities that guarantee a margin of excellence not provided by similar organizations.

VOLUNTEER

Volunteers serve in many capacities within Cedar Lake by contributing time and talent that help us fulfill our mission and enrich the lives of those we support. Sign up to volunteer today!

PARTICIPATE

Cedar Lake hosts two annual events. The Golf Tournament & Golf Ball Drop in the spring and the Hearts of Gold Gala in the fall.

Your privacy is important to us. To better protect your privacy we provide this notice explaining our online information practices. Our privacy policy is simple: we collect no information about you unless you choose to provide that information to us. In addition, we do not give, share, sell, or transfer any personal information about you to any third parties. To prevent unauthorized access, maintain accuracy, and ensure the correct use of information, we have put in place appropriate physical, electronic, and managerial procedures to safeguard and secure any information that we collect. If you have questions about our privacy practices, you can contact us at the postal or email address posted on this site.
